name: mirage
text: You're right, I gave you the old path. The separate Kalshi tab was merged into the +EV tab. Kalshi bets show in that list, labelled Kalshi, with Novig and Kalshi chips at the top. The engine's Kalshi lane is still OFF, so the list has none. To change it, open the +EV tab and tap the button 'Kalshi arb, bids, auto, setup'. It only shows while Kalshi is on. Go to Setup, then the GitHub engine section, and set the mode to Paper or Live. If you don't see the button, tell me which version you're on and what the venue chips show.
